description: Bounded OEC active-center source-row acquisition and immutable offline replay, without premises or business identity verification.
redirect_policy: Reject redirects; fixed h8mr-dn95 catalog and SODA2 endpoints only, no credentials or fallback.
retry: No automatic retry or fallback; publisher deferral stops the attempt.
checkpoint: Await durable prerequisite before membership and each validated observation journal before subsequent requests. Preserve complete acquisition independently of normalization.
idempotency: Immutable UUID-scoped acquisitions; reuse verified retained evidence offline. Partial journals are inspectable, not an automatic resume promise.
cancellation: Abort transport and pacing; drain cooperative retention hooks and owned writers. Clean only owned incomplete cancellation output and preserve uncertain publications.
retention_profile: Internal allowlisted source rows and sanitized metadata; no catalog cached samples or person/contact enrichment.
